messages:
maya: Quick sync — SOC2/ISO evidence sprint starts tomorrow. Need clear owners for: audit-log ingest, KMS rotation playbook, HSM attestation sample, legal sign-off. Goal: PRs for evidence items by EOD Friday. Tracker: https://go/reports/soc2-evidence (add your name below).
chris: I can own audit-log ingest (schema + example pipeline). Will open a PR for logs -> s3 pipeline. ETA Thu.
alex: I'll take KMS rotation playbook updates (runbook + play-by-play). @samir can you help with HSM attestation content?
samir: Yup — I can do HSM attestation snippet and coordinate infra for test certs. Need confirmation on allowed maintenance windows for HSM access. @eng-sre-bot any recent windows?
eng-sre-bot: Maintenance windows: next scheduled window 2026-06-18 02:00-04:00 UTC. Previous window: 2026-05-12 01:00-03:00 UTC.
jordan: Quick clarifier: should audit logs include dev clusters? Policy doc seems to call out prod + staging only.
maya: Confirmed — prod + staging only. Dev is excluded. I'll update tracker to avoid scope creep.
alex: FYI opened PR #5827 for KMS playbook (docs + runbook). @chris can you review the 'retention & rotation' section?
chris: On my list. Will review by EOD tomorrow.
olivia: I'm owning cross-team dependencies. Legal needs to sign off on ISO artifact 3 (evidence of controls). @maya can you loop them?
maya: Looping @legal-squad now — asked for review turnaround by Wed.
samir: HSM attestation token format we agreed on — posting sample to embed in evidence: ```json
{"attest_version":"v1","nonce":"<random>","hsm_id":"hsm-prod-2","timestamp":"2026-06-02T12:34:00Z"}
```
maya: Nice sample. Can someone add that to the evidence repo under docs/evidence/hsm-attestation.md? Also include a short validation snippet.
alex: I'll add the file and a validation curl example in the PR.
jordan: QA needs short-lived test creds for staging log ingest tests. @ops-ivan can you create creds valid 1 day? Ticket: https://tickets/inc-1234
ops-bot: Ticket INC-1234 assigned to @ops-ivan. ETA 1 business day.
maya: Thanks — I'll compile the owner roll-up and push an update to the tracker by this afternoon. If you pick up/change an item, please ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
